verdict.rationale: Trivy's source is hosted in a public GitHub repository (aquasecurity/trivy), and its own site frames it as an open source vulnerability scanner, so the source is readable. However, no evidence item names the license or its terms, so 'under an open license' is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. a LICENSE file or license name), first-party docs on licensing and contribution terms, independent corroboration of the license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: After evaluating several leading options for open source vulnerability scanning, Trivy really stood out
Trivy is available in most common distribution channels.
